# QCrypton PQC VPN Overlay — Hybrid Post-Quantum WireGuard Dashboard

Tunnel telemetry from PQC VPN Overlay instances. Tracks hybrid PQC adoption, classical fallback events, HNDL risk, policy enforcement, and tunnel lifecycle metrics. Data source: `PQCVPNOverlay_CL`.

content.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == 'tunnel_up'
| extend TunnelType = iff(PQCUsed == 1, 'PQC Hybrid', 'Classical')
| summarize Count = count() by TunnelType
| render piechart
content.title: PQC vs classical tunnel adoption

content.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == 'tunnel_up'
| summarize Count = count() by KeyExchange
| render piechart
content.title: Key exchange algorithm distribution

content.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType in ('tunnel_up', 'tunnel_down', 'classical_fallback', 'handshake_fail')
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), EventType
| render timechart
content.title: Tunnel lifecycle events over time

content.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == 'tunnel_up'
| summarize Protected = countif(HNDLRisk == 0), AtRisk = countif(HNDLRisk == 1) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: HNDL risk — protected vs at-risk tunnels over time

content.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType in ('policy_block', 'policy_warn')
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), EventType
| render timechart
content.title: Policy enforcement events over time

content.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == 'tunnel_up'
| summarize Tunnels = count(), PQC = countif(PQCUsed == 1), Classical = countif(PQCUsed == 0), AvgLatencyMs = round(avg(LatencyMs), 2) by PeerID
| extend PQCPct = round(100.0 * PQC / Tunnels, 1)
| project PeerID, Tunnels, PQC, Classical, PQCPct, AvgLatencyMs
| order by Tunnels desc
content.title: Per-peer tunnel summary

content.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventType == 'tunnel_down'
| summarize TotalSentGB = round(sum(BytesSent) / 1073741824.0, 2), TotalRecvGB = round(sum(BytesRecv) / 1073741824.0, 2), AvgDurationMin = round(avg(DurationSec) / 60.0, 1) by PeerID
| project PeerID, TotalSentGB, TotalRecvGB, AvgDurationMin
| order by TotalSentGB desc
content.title: Tunnel data volume by peer
